Name: ListQuotes
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: ListQuotes, command: many)
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.description,
  p.quote_date,
  c.company_name AS customer_name
FROM
  quotes p
JOIN
  customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id
WHERE
  p.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
  toDate(p.quote_date) DESC,
  p.id DESC
LIMIT {limit:UInt64} OFFSET {offset:UInt64};
Template:
SELECT
  ⟨c0:p.id⟩,
  ⟨c1:p.description⟩,
  ⟨c2:p.quote_date⟩,
  ⟨c3 aliased:c.company_name⟩ AS customer_name
FROM
  quotes p
JOIN
  customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id
WHERE
  p.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
  toDate(p.quote_date) DESC,
  p.id DESC
LIMIT ⟨p0 UInt64⟩ OFFSET ⟨p1 UInt64⟩;⟨arguments p0 p1⟩
